report:
Tested k2_v3.html in Chrome at 1280x720 with a scripted player (keyboard events + a read-only state probe).
Working now: start screen, arrow/A/D movement, Down/S/Space lowering, grab -> lift -> hold, held object drawn
under the jaws, drop into matching bin (+10, sorted +1), lose screen with final/best score, no console errors.

Remaining problems:

1. The game cannot be won. One pick-and-place cycle takes about 4.5 s (lowering ~1.7 s at 2.5 units/s, lifting
   ~1.7 s, moving + falling ~1 s) but a new object spawns every 1.6 s. Even a perfect scripted player sorted only
   4 objects before 3 objects fell off the belt and the game ended. Rebalance so that a skilled player can sort
   20 objects: e.g. lowering/lifting speed about 6 units/s, spawn interval about 3.0 s at level 1 shrinking by
   10 % per level (never below 1.8 s), belt speed 0.9 units/s at level 1. Keep the "objects falling off the end
   cost a life" rule.
2. HUD text (Score / Sorted / Level / Combo, top-left) overlaps the gripper and gantry when the gripper is on the
   left. Move the HUD into a top bar above the gantry (or a side panel) so nothing is drawn over it, and draw the
   gantry rail across the full width below the HUD.
3. The on-screen Restart button (bottom-right) covers part of the YELLOW bin. Move it (e.g. top-right corner).
4. The YELLOW label does not fit inside its bin; size labels to fit (e.g. measureText and shrink).
5. Win / lose / start overlay text is very small at 1280x720 (about 10 px). Use larger sizes (title ~48 px,
   lines ~20 px) that scale with the window.

  // ---------- object handling ----------
  function spawnObject() {
    const type = OBJECT_TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random()*OBJECT_TYPES.length)];
    const color = TYPE_COLOR[type];
    const size = 0.5 + Math.random()*0.3;
    objects.push({
      type, color,
      x: -size,
      y: BELT_Y + BELT_H/2 - size/2,
      w: size, h: size,
      shape: type
    });
  }

  function getBins() {
    const binW = 1.2, binH = 0.8, gap = 0.3;
    const totalW = binW*3 + gap*2;
    const startX = VIRTUAL_W - totalW - 0.5;
    const y = VIRTUAL_H - binH - 0.2;
    return [
      { x:startX, y, w:binW, h:binH, color:'red', label:'RED' },
      { x:startX+binW+gap, y, w:binW, h:binH, color:'blue', label:'BLUE' },
      { x:startX+2*(binW+gap), y, w:binW, h:binH, color:'yellow', label:'YELLOW' }
    ];
  }

  function dropObject() {
    if (!holdingObj) { gripperState = 'up'; gripperY = GRIPPER_UP_Y; return; }
    const obj = holdingObj;
    falling.push({
      x: gripperX - obj.w/2,
      y: gripperY + 0.5 + obj.h/2,
      w: obj.w, h: obj.h,
      color: obj.color,
      shape: obj.shape,
      vy: 0,
      falling: true
    });
    holdingObj = null;
    gripperState = 'up';
    gripperY = GRIPPER_UP_Y;
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== 'play') return;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

    if (keys['a'] || keys['left']) gripperX -= GRIPPER_MOVE_SPEED * dt;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['right']) gripperX += GRIPPER_MOVE_SPEED * dt;
    gripperX = Math.max(0.6, Math.min(VIRTUAL_W - 0.6, gripperX));

    spawnTimer += dt;
    if (spawnTimer > getSpawnInterval()) {
      spawnTimer = 0;
      spawnObject();
    }

    const beltSpeed = getBeltSpeed();
    for (const o of objects) o.x += beltSpeed * dt;
    objects = objects.filter(o => {
      if (o.x > VIRTUAL_W) {
        lives--;
        combo = 0;
        if (lives <= 0) endGame(false);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
    if (state !== 'play') return;

    if (gripperState === 'down') {
      const downSpeed = fastDrop ? FAST_DROP_SPEED : GRIPPER_DOWN_SPEED;
      if (gripperY < BELT_Y - 0.2) {
        gripperY += downSpeed * dt;
      } else {
        gripperY = BELT_Y - 0.2;
        const gx = gripperX;
        const reach = 0.3;
        const target = objects.find(o => gx >= o.x - reach && gx <= o.x + o.w + reach);
        if (target) {
          if (fastDrop && target.type === 'egg') {
            lives--;
            combo = 0;
            const cx = target.x + target.w/2;
            const cy = target.y + target.h/2;
            for (let i=0;i<6;i++) {
              particles.push({
                x: cx, y: cy,
                vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*2, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*2,
                life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: '#fff'
              });
            }
            for (let i=0;i<4;i++) {
              cracks.push({
                x: cx, y: cy,
                angle: Math.random()*Math.PI,
                length: target.w*0.7 + 0.1,
                size: 0.06,
                life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5,
                color: '#6b4a00'
              });
            }
            objects = objects.filter(o => o !== target);
            if (lives <= 0) endGame(false);
            gripperState = 'up';
            gripperY = GRIPPER_UP_Y;
          } else {
            holdingObj = target;
            objects = objects.filter(o => o !== target);
            gripperState = 'lifting';
          }
        } else {
          gripperState = 'up';
          gripperY = GRIPPER_UP_Y;
        }
      }
    }
    if (state !== 'play') return;

    if (gripperState === 'lifting') {
      if (gripperY > GRIPPER_UP_Y) {
        gripperY -= GRIPPER_UP_SPEED * dt;
      } else {
        gripperY = GRIPPER_UP_Y;
        gripperState = 'holding';
      }
    }

    for (let i=falling.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
      const f = falling[i];
      f.vy += 9.8 * dt;
      f.y += f.vy * dt;
      const bins = getBins();
      let landed = false;
      for (const b of bins) {
        const fx = f.x + f.w/2;
        if (fx >= b.x && fx <= b.x + b.w && f.y + f.h >= b.y) {
          landed = true;
          if (b.color === f.color) {
            score += 10;
            sorted++;
            combo++;
            if (combo >= 3) score += 5;
            for (let p=0;p<8;p++) {
              particles.push({
                x: f.x + f.w/2, y: f.y + f.h/2,
                vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*2, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*2,
                life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: COLORS[f.color]
              });
            }
            const newLevel = Math.floor(sorted/5) + 1;
            if (newLevel !== level) level = newLevel;
          } else {
            lives--;
            combo = 0;
            for (let p=0;p<5;p++) {
              particles.push({
                x: f.x + f.w/2, y: f.y + f.h/2,
                vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5,
                life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: '#888'
              });
            }
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!landed && f.y + f.h >= FLOOR_Y) {
        landed = true;
        lives--;
        combo = 0;
        for (let p=0;p<5;p++) {
          particles.push({
            x: f.x + f.w/2, y: f.y + f.h/2,
            vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5,
            life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: '#888'
          });
        }
      }
      if (landed) {
        falling.splice(i,1);
        if (lives <= 0) endGame(false);
        else if (sorted >= 20) endGame(true);
      }
    }
    if (state !== 'play') return;

    for (let i=particles.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
    }
    for (let i=cracks.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
      const c = cracks[i];
      c.life -= dt;
      if (c.life <= 0) cracks.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(offsetX, offsetY);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIRTUAL_W, VIRTUAL_H);

    drawHUD();
    drawGantry();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
    ctx.fillRect(0, BELT_Y, VIRTUAL_W, BELT_H);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.02;
    for (let x=0; x<VIRTUAL_W; x+=0.4) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, BELT_Y);
      ctx.lineTo(x-0.2, BELT_Y+BELT_H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    const bins = getBins();
    for (const b of bins) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[b.color];
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.03;
      ctx.strokeRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      let labelSize = 0.34;
      ctx.font = labelSize + 'px Arial';
      while (labelSize > 0.1 && ctx.measureText(b.label).width > b.w * 0.9) {
        labelSize -= 0.02;
        ctx.font = labelSize + 'px Arial';
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText(b.label, b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2);
    }

    for (const o of objects) drawObject(o);
    for (const f of falling) drawObject(f);
    drawGripper();

    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 0.05, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    for (const c of cracks) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, c.life / c.maxLife);
      ctx.strokeStyle = c.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = c.size;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);
      ctx.rotate(c.angle);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(c.length, 0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawGantry() {
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a4a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.07;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GANTRY_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(VIRTUAL_W, GANTRY_Y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawObject(o) {
    const cx = o.x + o.w/2, cy = o.y + o.h/2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[o.color];
    if (o.shape === 'cube') {
      ctx.fillRect(-o.w/2, -o.h/2, o.w, o.h);
    } else if (o.shape === 'cylinder') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, o.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillRect(-o.w/2, -o.h/2, o.w, o.h/2);
    } else if (o.shape === 'egg') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, o.w/2, o.h/2, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawGripper() {
    const jawW = 0.3, jawH = 0.5;
    const open = gripperState === 'up' || gripperState === 'down';
    const gap = open ? 0.15 : 0.02;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(gripperX, gripperY);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
    ctx.fillRect(-jawW/2 - gap/2, 0, jawW/2, jawH);
    ctx.fillRect(gap/2, 0, jawW/2, jawH);
    if (holdingObj && (gripperState === 'holding' || gripperState === 'lifting')) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(0, jawH);
      drawObject({ ...holdingObj, x: -holdingObj.w/2, y: 0 });
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#151515';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIRTUAL_W, HUD_H);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.04;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, HUD_H);
    ctx.lineTo(VIRTUAL_W, HUD_H);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '0.45px Arial';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 0.4, 0.22);
    ctx.fillText('Sorted: ' + sorted + ' / 20', 0.4, 0.66);

    for (let i=0; i<lives; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(4.0 + i*0.36, 0.82, 0.15, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('Level: ' + level, VIRTUAL_W - 1.0, 0.22);
    ctx.fillText('Combo: ' + combo, VIRTUAL_W - 1.0, 0.66);
  }

  // ---------- start screen ----------
  function showStartScreen() {
    title.textContent = 'Gripper Rush';
    msg.textContent = 'Sort 20 objects into the correct bins before you run out of 3 lives.';
    final.textContent = '';
    best.textContent = 'Best score: ' + bestScore;
    prompt.textContent = 'Press any key or click to start';
    overlay.classList.add('show');
  }
  showStartScreen();

  // ---------- main loop ----------
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
